name: Job Output Stream
description: A stream of output chunks and structured status for internal `fs` bulk background operations (not a standalone public job tool surface).

redaction.notes: All stream items MUST be redacted deterministically before persistence or emission.

ndjson.rules: Each line is a complete JSON object. Callers MUST tolerate chunking and resume using cursors/job offsets.
ndjson.ordering: Stable by emission order within the job.

log_record_schema.timestamp: string (RFC3339 UTC; seconds preferred; max milliseconds)
